_comment: Canonical partner-role registry. The canon names ROLES, never vendor models: the concrete model/partner binding per role is a project or deployment setting (project.json 'partners'). All calls go through the gateway (gateway.md); partners are stateless and never access the repo.

product-partner.tier: top on arch items, workhorse on exec items
product-partner.duty: product constraints, UX coherence, requirement coverage

design-partner.duty: implementation-level design consults within declared delegated decisions

reviewer-partner.duty: second-family consult on review disputes; a consult, never a verdict

ex-architect-partner.duty: external audit and dispute arbitration; stateless, no repo access
